name: Subsalve USA
old_description: Since 1977, we have provided solutions and expertise for aircraft recovery, ship, yacht, and boat salvage, marine construction, offshore oilfield diving, and explosive ordnance disposal.
about:
Subsalve USA is based in North Kingstown, Rhode Island, and was founded in 1977 by Richard Fryburg. The company began as a specialist in engineered inflatables for marine and military applications, and in 2017 it became part of Performance Inflatables Co LLC.

The company designs and manufactures a range of engineered inflatables, including underwater lift bags, inflation hose assemblies, station manifolds, inflation yoke assemblies, and acoustic and remote tablet actuation systems. It maintains an inventory of standard products and offers custom design services for specialized applications. Notable projects include supplying more than 600 tons of lift bags for the 2001 installation of the Spiegel Grove artificial reef and supporting James Cameron’s Deepsea Challenger mission in 2012.

Subsalve serves industries such as aircraft recovery, ship and boat salvage, marine construction, offshore oilfield diving, explosive ordnance disposal, pipeline and tunnel construction, proofload testing, public safety, research, and shipyard operations. Its customers include the U.S. Department of Defense, all branches of the U.S. Armed Forces, NASA, the FBI, private-sector companies, and governments of more than 30 foreign countries.

The company differentiates itself by using polyurethane-coated fabrics—nylon, polyester, and Kevlar—in all its lift bags, which it says provides superior puncture, abrasion, and chemical resistance. All products are made in the USA, tested before shipping, and carry a one-year warranty. Subsalve holds compliance with IMCA D-016-AIRBAGS, ABS, and U.S. Department of Defense standards, and holds multiple patents for its designs.
